approach:
Modify DurablePostAdmissionClassification to compute routing proofs dynamically based on individual provider results instead of relying solely on sealed effective conditions. Ensure that after a successful round, subsequent 404 responses trigger proper typed promotion to POST_ADMISSION_REJECTION only when they pertain to the exact same (provider, base_url, model) triplet established by prior success, keeping other HTTP codes like 401 non-retryable even after successes.
This addresses issues #1, #2, and #3 regarding multi-round proofs, narrow classification scope, and durability respectively.
